scope: Target-supervised appendix adapters; prerequisite only, fixed detector sources unchanged
not_canonical: tools/build_patches_and_train_lora.sh is a separate legacy3-epoch convenience route; its directory-valued output argument is repaired but it is not silently substituted

base.initialization: same existing base SARCLIP for each dataset-specific adapter
base.trainable: visual LoRA factors plus logit_scale only; text classifier/base weights frozen

adapter_training.sampler: inverse class-frequency, replacement=True, N accepted patches per epoch
adapter_training.launch_gate: actual TRAIN crop manifest/counts and final config must be available; no GPU launched by preparation

seed_policy.reuse: one fixed dataset-specific adapter shared by both oracle variants and detector seeds42/43/44
seed_policy.interpretation: detector-seed uncertainty conditional on fixed source and fixed adapter; not whole-pipeline adapter variance

RSAR.status: count/crop preparation required, not blocked merely by absent adapter

DIOR.prompt_basis: existing optical-domain wording, explicitly parameterized for DIOR; no change to the LoRA algorithm

observed_data_gap.upstream183_check: known00001.jpg TRAIN sample absent in each corresponding original corruption folder; not an exhaustive upstream search

DIOR.required_resolution: obtain matching TRAIN corruption images or their actual generating recipe/provenance; no VAL/TEST GT, clean-source TRAIN relabeling, or arbitrary cloudy-to-fog substitution
DIOR.status: trainer/crop interfaces implemented; actual corrupted-TRAIN inputs unresolved

isolation: Strict baselines and completed A-F never load these adapters
No detector-source replacement or source detector retraining
TRAIN labels only; no TEST labels or TEST-tuned checkpoint/epoch selection
No automatic visual-projection fallback masquerading as LoRA
